description: Karnataka IT-BT Minister Priyank Kharge told Moneycontrol the government is ‘agnostic’ and will work with any AI company that can boost AI skill development, improve governance and help startups create intellectual property.
body_lead: Karnataka is open to partnering with a range of artificial intelligence (AI) companies, including homegrown startup Sarvam AI, and is not limiting itself to Anthropic, IT-BT Minister Priyank Kharge told Moneycontrol. Responding to criticism that Karnataka government was favouring Anthropic over Sarvam AI, Kharge said state was engaging with multiple AI firms and was willing to work with any company that could help advance Karnataka's AI ambitions. Also, read: Karnataka, Anthropic to form AI working groups; expand AI skilling via Claude certifications "We are not going only for Anthropic.
